title: The AI Ghostwriter Effect: When Users Do Not Perceive Ownership of AI-Generated Text But Self-Declare as Authors
reasoning: The paper is a human-computer interaction (HCI) study that investigates the 'AI Ghostwriter Effect' (user perceptions of ownership and authorship in AI-collaborative writing). While it discusses the ethics of transparency and crediting AI, it focuses on human behavior and psychological ownership rather than evaluating or benchmarking the moral, ethical, or religious reasoning of the LLM itself.
